name: Law2_VolumeGeom_ViscoFrictPhys_Elastic
description: Law similar to Law2_VolumeGeom_FrictPhys_Elastic with the addition of shear creep at contacts.

attributes.name: volumePower
attributes.description: The exponent $a$ on the overlap volume within the contact law. Setting to 0.5 gives a near-linear relationship of force with respect to penetration distance for spheres.

attributes.name: neverErase
attributes.description: Keep interactions even if particles go away from each other (only useful if another contact law is used as well).

attributes.name: traceEnergy
attributes.description: Define the total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all contacts. This will trace only plastic energy in this law, see O.trackEnergy for a more complete energies tracing.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: plasticDissipation
methods.description: Total energy dissipated in plastic slips at all FrictPhys contacts. Computed only if Law2_VolumeGeom_FrictPhys_Elastic::traceEnergy is true.

methods.name: initPlasticDissipation
methods.description: Initialize cummulated plastic dissipation to a value (0 by default).

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
